properties.title: Alpe di Caviano
properties.description: The Alpe di Caviano, owned by the Patriziato of Castel San Pietro, is a modern and welcoming mountain retreat nestled in nature, ideal for groups, families, and couples. Accessible on foot from Castel San Pietro or from the Bellavista of Monte Generoso, it offers comfortable rooms, a loft for groups, a rustic-style restaurant, and a panoramic terrace perfect for moments of relaxation, with breathtaking views of the Alps. The Alpe di Caviano is part of Albergo Diffuso Monte Generoso, a project that enhances the region by offering authentic and sustainable experiences.
